title: Understanding the Data Analyst Salary Australia: Hourly Rates, Casual Loading, and Super
description: Learn how to convert a data analyst salary Australia from hourly to annual using 38-hour weeks, plus casual loading and super paid on top. Fair Work rates explained.

bodyMarkdown:
## Converting a Data Analyst Salary Australia from Hourly to Annual

When you see a **data analyst salary Australia** advertised, it may be quoted as an hourly rate or an annual salary. To compare offers, you need to convert between the two. The standard formula is:

**Annual gross ≈ hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

This assumes you work the same number of hours every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. For full-time work, the typical week is 38 hours, as set by the Fair Work Ombudsman and the National Employment Standards. If you are a data analyst working under a modern award, your minimum pay rate is based on a 38-hour week.

### Using the Timesheet Calculator

The [timesheet](/) on this site lets you enter your base hourly rate. A checkbox adds 25% casual loading on top. **Do not enter a rate that already includes casual loading** – the calculator applies it for you. It then shows your annual gross, fortnightly pay, tax estimate, and super paid on top.

### Fortnightly Pay

A fortnight is two weeks of work. For a 38-hour week, that is 76 hours. If your base rate is $35 per hour, your fortnightly gross is $2,660 ($35 × 76). After tax and Medicare, your take-home pay is lower. The calculator shows both weekly and fortnightly amounts.

## Minimum Pay Rates for Data Analysts

A data analyst salary Australia must meet the National Minimum Wage or the relevant award rate. From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour ($1,004.90 per week for 38 hours). Casual employees get a 25% loading, making the minimum casual rate $33.05 per hour.

Many data analysts are covered by the *Professional Employees Award 2020* or the *Clerks – Private Sector Award 2020*. These awards have higher minimum rates depending on classification. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides [pay guides](/blog) for each award. Check the guide that applies to your job title and industry.

### Award Rates vs Recruiter Surveys

Web search results for “data analyst salary australia” often show recruiter surveys with averages much higher than award minimums. Those surveys may include bonuses, allowances, and company size. For a reliable minimum, always refer to the Fair Work Ombudsman or the Fair Work Commission’s Modern Awards Pay Database. The Commission publishes calculated minimum rates, allowances, and penalty rates for each award.

## Casual Loading and Super

Casual employees in Australia get a 25% loading instead of paid leave. This loading is applied to the base hourly rate. For a data analyst earning $35 per hour base, the casual rate is $43.75 per hour. The loading compensates for not receiving sick leave or annual leave.

Superannuation is paid **on top** of ordinary earnings. The super guarantee is 12% of ordinary time earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 (2026-27). For a full-time data analyst earning $69,160 annually, the employer pays an extra $8,299.20 into your super fund. This is not deducted from your pay – it is an additional cost to the employer.

### Example: Data Analyst Salary Australia

Assume a data analyst works 38 hours per week at a base rate of $35 per hour.

- Annual gross: $35 × 38 × 52 = $69,160
- Fortnightly gross: $35 × 76 = $2,660
- Casual loading (if applicable): $35 × 1.25 = $43.75 per hour; annual gross $90,350
- Super (12%): $8,299.20 on top of $69,160
- Tax (2026-27 resident): approximately $11,317 plus Medicare $1,383
- Take-home pay (excluding super): about $56,460 per year

Use the [job pay](/topics/job-pay) page to see how different classifications affect your rate.

## Tax and Medicare

The Australian Taxation Office sets the 2026-27 resident tax rates:
- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on the next $26,800 (to $45,000)
- 30% on the next $90,000 (to $135,000)
- 37% on the next $55,000 (to $190,000)
- 45% above $190,000

Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. The calculator uses the 2025-26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026-27 thresholds were not confirmed. This is an estimate only.

## Important Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

For precise rates, refer to the [reference tables](/data) on this site or the official Fair Work Ombudsman pay guides.
